claims: No. 3 seed Michigan State defeated No. 6 seed Louisville 77-69 in the 2026 NCAA Tournament Round of 32
Michigan State advanced to the Sweet 16
Coen Carr had 21 points for Michigan State
Coen Carr had 10 rebounds for Michigan State
Jeremy Fears Jr. had 12 points for Michigan State
Jeremy Fears Jr. had 16 assists for Michigan State
Jeremy Fears Jr.'s 16 assists set a Michigan State NCAA tournament record
Louisville played without injured guard Mikel Brown Jr.
Ryan Conwell had 21 points for Louisville
Adrian Wooley had 17 points for Louisville
Michigan State had a 13-3 run in the second half
The 13-3 run extended Michigan State's lead to 63-50
Michigan State advances to face the winner of UConn/UCLA in the East Regional
Louisville's season ended in coach Pat Kelsey's second season
